title: NADA global data structure (DSD) — create / import
description: Payload for creating a catalogue global DSD (data_structures + components) and associated global codelists. Each component's codelist binding is a single nested 'codelist' object: identity fields (idno/name/agency/version/description) plus an 'items' array for the codes. Reuse an existing codelist by supplying only 'codelist.idno'. Codelist items: code, label, description, sort_order, parent_id — no translations. Cross-field rules (e.g. required codelist for dimension) are enforced by the API, not this schema. For study-level inline DSD see timeseries-schema.json data_structure.

codeListItem.description: One code in a global codelist. Maps to codelist_item: code, title (from label), sort_order, parent_id. Description is carried in the payload for documentation or import logic if the persistence layer supports it.

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable code value (unique within the codelist).

label.title: Label
label.description: Display label; import maps to codelist_item.title when persisting.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional longer text; import may persist if supported or ignore.

parent_id.title: Parent item id
parent_id.description: Optional codelist_item.id of the parent row for hierarchies; use when parent already exists (e.g. second import pass).

externalCodeListRef.title: External code list reference
externalCodeListRef.description: Reference to an external code list (e.g. SDMX registry URI). Import APIs may ignore or resolve separately.

codelistBinding.description: Nested codelist binding for a component. Reuse existing catalogue codelist by supplying only 'idno'. Create a new codelist by supplying 'idno' + 'name' (and optional agency/version/description) together with 'items'. When the list already exists and 'items' is present, it is applied only if the import is run with overwrite_codelists=true; otherwise items are ignored with a warning.

idno.title: Codelist idno
idno.description: Catalogue codelist idno. Required to reuse an existing codelist; required when creating a new codelist so studies can reference it stably.

name.title: Codelist maintainable name
name.description: Required when creating a new codelist.

agency.title: Agency
agency.description: Defaults to NADA in API if omitted.

version.title: Version
version.description: Defaults to 1.0 in API if omitted.

items.title: Codelist items
items.description: Codes to load when creating a new codelist (or when overwrite_codelists is set on existing).

dsdComponent.description: One DSD column. For dimension/geography, supply a 'codelist' object: either 'codelist': { idno } to reuse an existing global codelist, or 'codelist': { idno, name, items: [...] } to create one.

name.title: Name
name.description: Field name in observations; must not start with underscore.

paired_time_column.title: Paired time_period component name
paired_time_column.description: Name of the sibling component with column_type time_period (e.g. periodicity paired with TIME_PERIOD). Logical reference only.

structure.description: Global DSD catalogue identity (data_structures). idno is the value studies use in metadata.data_structure_reference.

agency.title: Agency
agency.description: Defaults to NADA in API if omitted.

version.title: Version
version.description: Defaults to 1.0 in API if omitted.

idno.title: DSD idno
idno.description: Stable catalogue idno; required here so imports and studies can reference it explicitly.

importOptions.description: Optional flags for bulk import APIs.

overwrite_codelists.title: Overwrite existing codelist items
overwrite_codelists.description: When true, replace codes on matched codelists; when false, reuse existing lists without mutating items.

dry_run.title: Dry run
dry_run.description: When true, validate only; do not persist.
